brique._comment: Engine-native Matter family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: structure.patch
objective.description: Apply an ordered patch list to one existing structure descriptor.

#root.role: Validate one patch set, optionally enforce an expected revision, and commit the patched structure descriptor with a bumped revision.

structure_id._comment: Required. Name of the structure to patch (without .json extension).

exp_rev._comment: Optional optimistic revision guard. When non-zero, the patch is refused if the current revision differs.

patches._comment: Ordered descriptor patch list applied sequentially. Required unless semantic_patch is supplied. Each patch: { path: string[] (array of JSON key segments identifying the target location, e.g. ['functional', 'tags', 'domain']), value: any (new value to set at that path) }. Patches are applied in order; each one navigates the path and sets the value. path is always a JSON array, never dot-notation.

semantic_patch._comment: Optional terminal semantic value add/remove operations: { add: [{path: string[] (array of key segments), value: any}], remove: [{path: string[], value: any}] }. path is always a JSON array of strings, never dot-notation. path[0] MUST be one of the structure descriptor root sections — objective, subjective, functional, brique — or the whole call fails with reason=invalid_patch and no operation is applied.

revision._comment: New revision number after the patch.

effects.structure_descriptor: The local structure JSON file is rewritten.
effects.catalog: The local structure catalog revision is updated.

transformation_contract.morphing: A structure identifier plus an ordered patch list becomes a new committed structure revision when all patches validate and apply successfully.
invariants: structure.patch only rewrites the descriptor of an existing local structure.
patches are applied in order and semantic_patch add/remove operations are applied to terminal values; the commit boundary yields exactly one new revision on success.
At least one of patches or semantic_patch must carry a non-empty mutation intent.
When exp_rev is supplied and non-zero, the current structure revision must match before any patch is committed.
success: On success, structure.patch returns ok=true, the structure_id, and the committed new revision.
Successful patching rewrites the local structure JSON file and refreshes the catalog projection.
failure: The capacity fails when structure_id is missing or neither patches nor semantic_patch provides a non-empty mutation intent.
The capacity refuses patching when the structure is absent from the runtime catalog or when exp_rev mismatches the current revision.
The capacity fails when any patch is invalid, cannot apply cleanly, or the committed descriptor cannot be written back to disk.
notes: Patch semantics are descriptor-only; structures do not have a separate substance payload.
The resulting revision is generated by the engine at commit time.
